waveform_conventions.physical_parameters: tc, phic, and f_ref forwarded directly as declared without internal shifts
waveform_conventions.amplitude_scaling: no amplitude rescaling or normalization factor applied
waveform_conventions.optimized_match_role: diagnostic metric independently optimized over time and phase per component; never a convention correction or amplitude certification
waveform_conventions.model_conventions_status: Only reported configurations are tested; passing a case does not certify a model parameter domain.

TaylorF2_HM.reason: The public TaylorF2 API returns one carrier series; its mode-array metadata does not change that output, and SimInspiralChooseFDModes has no TaylorF2 mode generator. Higher-mode full-waveform parity therefore has no stable external reference.
